payload.text: CAPABILITY (cross-asset carry-seam reach): is_cross_asset is the pure routing predicate that decides — by Underlying variant alone (Equity | Commodity | DigitalAsset) — which instruments leave the FX vanilla path for the cross-asset leaf engines (equity generalized-BSM, commodity Black-76, crypto inverse/linear) on the shared carry seam. FX/metal stays on the vanilla path (metal lease rate modelled as the FX foreign rate), byte-identically. Side-effect-free classifier: reads only the &Underlying, returns bool, no WRITES — the gate self-invalidates if the variant set or the routing shifts.
